sloka: तस्यैवं चिन्तयानस्य भवनं शशिसन्निभम् ।रामस्य परमोदारं पुरस्तान्समदृश्यत ।। ७.५२.४ ॥
transliteration: tasyaivaṁ cintayānasya bhavanaṁ śaśisannibham ।rāmasya paramodāraṁ purastānsamadṛśyata ।। 7.52.4 ॥

translations.english: As he was thus contemplating, Rama's most magnificent palace, shining like the moon, appeared before him.
translations.hindi: हे प्रभो ! में तुम्हारी आज्ञा पा, कुवेर के पास गया था | उन्होंने मुझसे यह कहा है
